<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Laughing golden creature</title>
<style>
html, body { width: 216px; height: 216px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
canvas { display: block; width: 216px; height: 216px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xe9ece9);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(216, 216);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-108, 108, 108, -108, 0.1, 1000);
ref.position.set(0, 0, 420);
ref.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
ref.layers.enable(1);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff9eb, 0xe1d6c7, 1.68));
function light(color, intensity, x, y, z) {
  const lamp = new THREE.DirectionalLight(color, intensity);
  lamp.position.set(x, y, z);
  scene.add(lamp);
}
light(0xfff3d9, 2.08, -115, 195, 160);
light(0xeef4ff, .61, 130, 40, 115);
light(0xfff5da, 1.12, 55, 135, -150);

const backdrop = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(850, 740),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      high: { value: new THREE.Color(0xf3f5f2) },
      low: { value: new THREE.Color(0xd2d6d4) },
      warm: { value: new THREE.Color(0xf8f6ef) }
    },
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 paper;
      void main() {
        paper = position.xy;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      varying vec2 paper;
      uniform vec3 high;
      uniform vec3 low;
      uniform vec3 warm;
      float hash(vec2 p) {
        return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(127.1,311.7))) * 43758.5453);
      }
      float cloud(vec2 p) {
        vec2 i = floor(p), f = fract(p);
        f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
        return mix(mix(hash(i), hash(i + vec2(1,0)), f.x),
                   mix(hash(i + vec2(0,1)), hash(i + vec2(1,1)), f.x), f.y);
      }
      void main() {
        float bank = -77.0 + 7.0 * sin(paper.x * .033)
                     + 11.0 * (cloud(paper * .027 + 8.0) - .5);
        float ground = 1.0 - smoothstep(bank - 30.0, bank + 15.0, paper.y);
        vec3 c = mix(high, low, ground * .96);
        c = mix(c, warm, .23 * cloud(paper * .021 + 14.0) * (1.0 - ground));
        c += (cloud(paper * .088) - .5) * .024;
        c += (hash(gl_FragCoord.xy) - .5) * .011;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.0);
        #include <colorspace_fragment>
      }
    `
  })
);
backdrop.name = 'soft-studio-backdrop';
backdrop.position.z = -170;
backdrop.layers.set(1);
scene.add(backdrop);

const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const V = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
const pixel = (x, y, z) => V(x - 108, 108 - y, z);
const { smoothstep: smooth, clamp, lerp } = THREE.MathUtils;

function group(name, parent, position) {
  const object = new THREE.Group();
  object.name = name;
  if (position) object.position.copy(position);
  parent.add(object);
  return object;
}

function mesh(parent, name, geometry, material) {
  const object = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  object.name = name;
  parent.add(object);
  return object;
}

function colorMesh(positions, colors, indices) {
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  if (colors.length) geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  return geometry;
}

function joinRings(indices, ringCount, sides, reverse = false) {
  for (let j = 0; j < ringCount - 1; j++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = j * sides + i;
      const b = j * sides + (i + 1) % sides;
      const c = a + sides;
      const d = b + sides;
      if (reverse) indices.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
      else indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c);
    }
  }
}

const gold = new THREE.Color(0xd5a331);
const goldLight = new THREE.Color(0xe0b442);
const goldShade = new THREE.Color(0xa66c20);
const belly = new THREE.Color(0xc29d77);
const bellyEdge = new THREE.Color(0xbf9568);
const palmColor = new THREE.Color(0x514a37);
const fingerColor = new THREE.Color(0x494335);
const skinMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xffffff, vertexColors: true, roughness: .95
});
const handMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xffffff, vertexColors: true, roughness: .94
});
const toothMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf8eacd, roughness: .78 });

function skinShade(t, u, v) {
  return gold.clone().lerp(goldLight, .17 + .13 * v)
    .lerp(goldShade, .12 * Math.max(0, -v) + .08 * t ** 3);
}

function tube(parent, name, rows, shade, material, steps = 40, sides = 40) {
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  const positions = new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute((steps + 1) * sides * 3, 3);
  const colors = new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute((steps + 1) * sides * 3, 3);
  positions.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
  geometry.setAttribute('position', positions);
  geometry.setAttribute('color', colors);
  const indices = [];
  joinRings(indices, steps + 1, sides);
  for (let i = 1; i < sides - 1; i++) {
    indices.push(0, i + 1, i);
    const end = steps * sides;
    indices.push(end, end + i, end + i + 1);
  }
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  mesh(parent, name, geometry, material);

  const circle = Array.from({ length: sides }, (_, i) =>
    [Math.cos(i / sides * TAU), Math.sin(i / sides * TAU)]);
  const across = V(0, 0, 0);
  const depth = V(0, 0, 0);
  const front = V(0, 0, 1);
  const center = V(0, 0, 0);
  const tangent = V(0, 0, 0);
  const radius = V(0, 0, 0);
  const point = V(0, 0, 0);

  function pose(profile, paint = false) {
    const guide = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
      profile.map(([x, y, z]) => V(x, y, z)), false, 'catmullrom', .43);
    const widths = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
      profile.map((row, i) => V(row[3], row[4], i)), false, 'catmullrom', .4);
    for (let j = 0; j <= steps; j++) {
      const t = j / steps;
      const parameter = guide.getUtoTmapping(t);
      guide.getPoint(parameter, center);
      guide.getTangent(parameter, tangent);
      widths.getPoint(parameter, radius);
      across.crossVectors(front, tangent);
      if (across.lengthSq() < .00001) across.set(1, 0, 0);
      across.normalize();
      depth.crossVectors(tangent, across).normalize();
      for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
        const [u, v] = circle[i];
        point.copy(center)
          .addScaledVector(across, u * Math.max(.04, radius.x))
          .addScaledVector(depth, v * Math.max(.04, radius.y));
        const index = j * sides + i;
        positions.setXYZ(index, point.x, point.y, point.z);
        if (paint) {
          const color = shade(t, u, v, point);
          colors.setXYZ(index, color.r, color.g, color.b);
        }
      }
    }
    positions.needsUpdate = true;
    geometry.computeVertexNormals();
    geometry.computeBoundingBox();
    geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
  }
  pose(rows, true);
  return { geometry, pose };
}

const character = group('character-laughing-golden-creature', scene);
const torso = group('torso', character);

function stageRows(rows, origin = V(0, 0, 0)) {
  return rows.map(([y, x, z, width, depth]) =>
    [x - 108 - origin.x, 108 - y - origin.y, z - origin.z, width, depth]);
}

const torsoRows = [
  [48,110,-8,.5,.5], [52,111,-8,18,15], [61,113,-9,32,25],
  [78,116,-11,40,32], [97,119,-11,43,36], [115,121,-10,44,40],
  [137,123,-9,45,41], [155,124,-8,44,38], [170,125,-8,38,32],
  [183,125,-8,28,25], [190,125,-8,17,15], [193,125,-8,.5,.5]
];
const body = tube(torso, 'rounded-body-and-belly-patch', stageRows(torsoRows),
  (t, u, v, p) => {
    const y = 108 - p.y;
    const x = p.x + 108;
    const middle = 117 - (y - 139) * .13;
    const dy = (y - 139) / 30.2;
    const dx = (x - middle) / (34.5 - 2.9 * smooth(y, 145, 170));
    const outline = Math.abs(dx) ** 2.45 + Math.abs(dy) ** 2.10;
    const patch = (1 - smooth(outline, .96, 1.045)) * smooth(v, .05, .32);
    const grain = Math.sin(x * 1.7 + y * 1.4) * Math.cos(y * 2.1 - x * .42);
    const bodyGold = skinShade(t, u, v).lerp(goldShade, .11 * Math.abs(u) ** 3);
    const patchColor = belly.clone().lerp(bellyEdge, .27 * Math.max(0, dy) + .11 * dx * dx);
    return bodyGold.lerp(patchColor, patch).multiplyScalar(1 + .014 * grain);
  }, skinMaterial, 104, 128);
const bodyRest = body.geometry.attributes.position.array.slice();

const neckRows = [
  [37,120,17,.4,.4], [47,120,15,22,17], [60,120,10,26,23],
  [74,121,5,27,26], [88,121,0,21,22], [97,122,0,.5,.5]
];
const neckGroup = group('neck', torso);
const neck = tube(neckGroup, 'neck-skin', stageRows(neckRows), skinShade, skinMaterial);

const leftLegRows = [
  [149,104,-6,3,4], [160,101,-3,19,25], [173,102,0,20,24],
  [190,107,2,17,19], [205,110,5,14.3,16], [226,107,8,14.5,15],
  [241,106,10,13,15], [250,106,11,2,2]
];
const rightLegRows = [
  [146,147,-8,3,3], [159,150,-6,22,26], [179,151,-1,24,24],
  [195,151,1,20,21], [211,155,4,18.2,18], [229,157,7,16.8,17],
  [242,157,7,15,16], [250,158,8,2,2]
];

function makeLeg(name, rows, footX, footZ, width) {
  const root = group(name, character);
  const skin = tube(root, 'leg-skin', stageRows(rows), skinShade, skinMaterial);
  const foot = group('foot', root, pixel(footX, 247, footZ));
  const sole = mesh(foot, 'rounded-foot', new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 32, 22),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xcb962e, roughness: .92 }));
  sole.scale.set(width, 9, 20);
  sole.position.set(0, -1, 4);
  return { skin, rows };
}
const leftLeg = makeLeg('leg-image-left', leftLegRows, 105, 15, 15);
const rightLeg = makeLeg('leg-image-right', rightLegRows, 159, 12, 18);

const leftArmRows = [
  [54,96,-5,1,1], [62,89,-4,14,17], [75,82,-3,17.8,19],
  [94,78,2,13.5,16], [115,78.5,6,11.3,14], [136,82,14,10.4,12.5],
  [155,88,24,8.8,10], [171,90,35,7.3,8], [177,89,39,5.6,6]
];
const rightArmRows = [
  [52,144,-5,1,1], [66,151,-4,14.2,17], [85,162,-1,18.7,21],
  [105,171,5,22.5,25], [124,173,15,23.5,27], [141,170,25,20.9,25],
  [156,164,35,15.6,20], [171,159,45,11.2,14], [180,158,48,8.2,9.5]
];
function makeArm(name, rows, shade) {
  const root = group(name, character);
  const skin = tube(root, 'arm-skin', stageRows(rows), shade, skinMaterial);
  return { root, skin, rows };
}
const leftArm = makeArm('arm-image-left', leftArmRows, (t, u, v) =>
  skinShade(t, u, v).lerp(goldShade, .30 * Math.max(0, u) * smooth(t, .26, .73)));
const rightArm = makeArm('arm-image-right', rightArmRows, (t, u, v) =>
  skinShade(t, u, v).lerp(goldShade,
    .26 * Math.max(0, -u) * smooth(t, .25, .52) + .08 * smooth(t, .68, 1)));

function hand(arm, name, base, palm, fingers) {
  const pivot = group(name, arm.root, pixel(...base));
  const surface = (t, u, v) => palmColor.clone().multiplyScalar(.86 + .18 * Math.max(0, v));
  tube(pivot, 'palm', palm, surface, handMaterial, 26, 32);
  for (const [fingerName, rows] of fingers) {
    const [sx, sy, sz] = rows[0];
    const digit = group(fingerName, pivot, V(sx, sy, sz));
    tube(digit, 'rounded-digit', rows.map(([x, y, z, r, ratio]) =>
      [x - sx, y - sy, z - sz, r, r * (ratio || .76)]), (t, u, v) =>
      fingerColor.clone().lerp(palmColor, (1 - t) * .56)
        .multiplyScalar(.87 + .16 * Math.max(v, 0)), handMaterial, 24, 18);
  }
  arm.hand = pivot;
  arm.handBase = base;
}

hand(leftArm, 'hand-image-left', [88.7,176.2,41], [
  [1,4,-1,2.8,2.9], [0,1,0,6.5,4.9], [-1.4,-3.2,1.7,8.3,5.1],
  [-2.6,-7,2.7,7.4,4.5], [-3,-10,1.8,3,2.5], [-3.3,-11.5,1,.2,.2]
], [
  ['little-finger', [[-6.3,-5,3,2.5],[-9.1,-8.8,4,2.3],[-10.5,-14.2,3.6,1.9],[-10.6,-17,2.7,1.35],[-10.3,-18,2.5,.14]]],
  ['ring-finger', [[-4.3,-7.1,4.2,2.8],[-6.8,-12.7,5.1,2.4],[-7.7,-17.6,4.6,2],[-7.1,-20.5,3.7,1.45],[-6.5,-21.2,3.4,.13]]],
  ['middle-finger', [[-.7,-7.3,4.7,2.75],[-2.4,-12.8,5.8,2.3],[-1.8,-17.8,4.8,1.9],[-1.2,-19.7,4,1],[-.9,-20.1,3.6,.11]]],
  ['index-finger', [[2.4,-6,4.5,2.55],[2.9,-10.8,5.7,2.35],[4.2,-14.4,5.1,2],[4.4,-16.8,4.2,1.4],[4.1,-17.6,3.9,.12]]],
  ['thumb', [[4.7,-1.3,2.6,3.3],[7.4,-5.7,4.7,2.8],[9.6,-9.4,5,2.2],[9.4,-12.2,4,1.4],[8.9,-12.8,3.7,.13]]]
]);

hand(rightArm, 'hand-image-right', [157.4,179.6,53], [
  [2.2,5,-1,4,3.7], [1.1,2,0,8.6,5.5], [0,-2.9,1.7,10.4,6.2],
  [-.7,-7.1,2,9.2,5.6], [-.3,-10,1.9,4.3,3], [0,-11.8,1.6,.2,.2]
], [
  ['thumb', [[-6,-1.3,3.3,3.55],[-9.4,-5.5,5.1,3.15],[-12,-9.9,5.4,2.55],[-12.6,-13,4.6,1.95],[-12.3,-14.7,4,.15]]],
  ['index-finger', [[-4.7,-6,5.1,3.2],[-6.2,-11.6,6,2.9],[-6.6,-16.4,5.2,2.45],[-5.9,-19.9,4.4,1.8],[-5.4,-20.6,4,.15]]],
  ['middle-finger', [[-.1,-7,5.8,3.25],[.4,-12.8,7,2.95],[1.5,-17.8,6.1,2.55],[2.5,-21,4.9,1.65],[3.1,-21.6,4.6,.14]]],
  ['ring-finger', [[4.2,-5.9,5.5,3.05],[6.1,-11.4,6.1,2.8],[8.3,-15.9,5.4,2.4],[9.9,-18.3,4.3,1.65],[10.6,-18.6,3.9,.13]]],
  ['little-finger', [[7.6,-3.7,3.9,2.65],[10.4,-7.4,4.9,2.45],[12.6,-10.1,4.6,2.1],[14.4,-11.7,3.7,1.55],[15.2,-11.7,3.4,.14]]]
]);

const head = group('head', character);
const rx = 29.4;
const ry = 34.6;
const rz = 26.9;
function faceZ(x, y) {
  return rz * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - (x / rx) ** 2 - (y / ry) ** 2));
}

const mouthShape = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
  V(-16,8.1,0), V(-13.4,12.1,0), V(-6,13,0), V(2.4,12.6,0),
  V(10.9,11.8,0), V(17.1,8.7,0), V(17.7,4.3,0), V(15,-4.8,0),
  V(10.2,-13.8,0), V(4.3,-21.7,0), V(-3.2,-25.4,0),
  V(-9.7,-23.5,0), V(-13.6,-18.3,0), V(-15.9,-8.5,0), V(-16.7,1.4,0)
], true, 'catmullrom', .44);

const faceSides = 128;
const faceRings = 44;
const backRings = 24;
const outline = [];
const surfacePositions = [];
const surfaceColors = [];
const surfaceIndices = [];
const ochreLip = new THREE.Color(0xb3832b);
const headGold = new THREE.Color(0xe0b542);
const lipHighlight = new THREE.Color(0xe9c15e);

for (let i = 0; i < faceSides; i++) {
  const p = mouthShape.getPointAt(i / faceSides);
  const dx = p.x;
  const dy = p.y + 5;
  const a = (dx / rx) ** 2 + (dy / ry) ** 2;
  const b = -10 * dy / (ry * ry);
  const c = (5 / ry) ** 2 - 1;
  const k = (-b + Math.sqrt(b * b - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a);
  outline.push({ p, x: k * dx, y: -5 + k * dy });
}

for (let j = 0; j <= faceRings + backRings; j++) {
  for (const {p, x, y} of outline) {
    let px, py, pz, color;
    if (j <= faceRings) {
      const t = j / faceRings;
      const s = Math.sin(t * Math.PI / 2);
      px = lerp(p.x, x, s);
      py = lerp(p.y, y, s);
      const lip = Math.exp(-(((t - .065) / .057) ** 2));
      pz = faceZ(px, py) + lip * (py < -10 ? 1.22 : .66);
      color = headGold.clone().lerp(goldShade, .17 * (1 - smooth(py, -30, -4)));
      color.lerp(ochreLip, (1 - smooth(t, 0, .084)) * .57);
      color.lerp(lipHighlight, lip * .43 * (1 - smooth(py, -18, -7)));
      const grain = Math.sin(px * 1.46 + py * .91) * Math.sin(py * 2.07 - px * .59);
      color.multiplyScalar(1 + .017 * grain);
    } else {
      const a = (j - faceRings) / backRings * (Math.PI / 2 - .001);
      px = x * Math.cos(a);
      py = y * Math.cos(a);
      pz = -rz * Math.sin(a);
      color = headGold.clone().lerp(gold, .25 * Math.sin(a));
      color.lerp(goldShade, .17 * (1 - smooth(py, -30, -4)));
    }
    surfacePositions.push(px, py, pz);
    surfaceColors.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
  }
}
joinRings(surfaceIndices, faceRings + backRings + 1, faceSides);
const rearEnd = (faceRings + backRings) * faceSides;
for (let i = 1; i < faceSides - 1; i++) surfaceIndices.push(rearEnd, rearEnd + i, rearEnd + i + 1);
const headSkin = mesh(head, 'sculpted-head-with-mouth-opening',
  colorMesh(surfacePositions, surfaceColors, surfaceIndices), skinMaterial);

const mouth = group('mouth', head);
const cavityPositions = [];
const cavityColors = [];
const cavityIndices = [];
const throatDark = new THREE.Color(0x0a0604);
const innerWall = new THREE.Color(0x41271a);
const cavityRings = 23;
for (let j = 0; j <= cavityRings; j++) {
  const t = j / cavityRings;
  for (const {p} of outline) {
    const x = p.x * (1 - t) - .8 * t;
    const y = (p.y + 5.8) * (1 - t) - 5.8;
    const z = lerp(faceZ(p.x, p.y) + .12, 5.6, Math.sin(t * Math.PI / 2));
    cavityPositions.push(x, y, z);
    const rim = (1 - smooth(t, 0, .25)) * (.48 + .32 * (1 - smooth(p.y, -24, 2)));
    const color = throatDark.clone().lerp(innerWall, rim);
    cavityColors.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
  }
}
joinRings(cavityIndices, cavityRings + 1, faceSides, true);
mesh(mouth, 'recessed-mouth-interior', colorMesh(cavityPositions, cavityColors, cavityIndices),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ vertexColors: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide }));

function faceStroke(parent, name, points, color) {
  const center = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(([x, y, inset]) =>
    V(x, y, faceZ(x, y) + inset)), false, 'catmullrom', .46);
  const radii = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map((p, i) =>
    V(p[3], i, 0)), false, 'catmullrom', .43);
  const positions = [];
  const indices = [];
  const steps = 36;
  const sides = 12;
  const frames = center.computeFrenetFrames(steps, false);
  for (let j = 0; j <= steps; j++) {
    const t = j / steps;
    const p = center.getPointAt(t);
    const radius = Math.max(.055, radii.getPoint(center.getUtoTmapping(t)).x);
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = i * TAU / sides;
      const q = p.clone().addScaledVector(frames.normals[j], Math.cos(a) * radius)
        .addScaledVector(frames.binormals[j], Math.sin(a) * radius);
      positions.push(q.x, q.y, q.z);
    }
  }
  joinRings(indices, steps + 1, sides, true);
  mesh(parent, name, colorMesh(positions, [], indices),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness: .88, side: THREE.DoubleSide }));
}

const eyes = group('eyes', head);
faceStroke(group('closed-eye-image-left', eyes), 'arched-eyelid', [
  [-24,18.3,.08,.12], [-22,21.4,.15,.66], [-18.8,23.8,.22,1.05],
  [-15.1,24.4,.24,1.09], [-12.1,23.4,.18,.69], [-10.1,21.9,.05,.11]
], 0x392514);
faceStroke(group('closed-eye-image-right', eyes), 'arched-eyelid', [
  [8.1,22,.08,.12], [11.4,24,.18,.75], [15.4,24.5,.25,1.11],
  [19.7,23.1,.24,1.14], [22.2,20.3,.17,.76], [23.3,17.4,.05,.12]
], 0x392514);

const teeth = group('teeth', mouth);
function tooth(name, x, y, w, h, angle, depth) {
  const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 16, 12);
  const vertices = geo.attributes.position;
  const ca = Math.cos(angle);
  const sa = Math.sin(angle);
  for (let i = 0; i < vertices.count; i++) {
    const bx = vertices.getX(i);
    const by = vertices.getY(i);
    const bz = vertices.getZ(i);
    const u = Math.sign(bx) * Math.abs(bx) ** .71 * w * .5 * (1 + .18 * by);
    const v = Math.sign(by) * Math.abs(by) ** .71 * h * .5;
    const fx = x + u * ca - v * sa;
    const fy = y + u * sa + v * ca;
    vertices.setXYZ(i, fx, fy, faceZ(fx, fy) + depth + 1.26 * bz);
  }
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  mesh(teeth, name, geo, toothMaterial);
}

const jawSurfaces = [];
function registerJaw(object) {
  const geo = object.geometry;
  const positions = geo.attributes.position;
  positions.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
  const rest = positions.array.slice();
  const weights = new Float32Array(positions.count);
  for (let i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
    const y = rest[i * 3 + 1];
    const z = rest[i * 3 + 2];
    weights[i] = clamp((10 - y) / 35, 0, 1) * smooth(z, 0, 11);
  }
  jawSurfaces.push({ geo, positions, rest, weights });
}

const intervals = times.map((time, i) => (times[i + 1] ?? period) - time);
const tangents = {};
for (const [name, samples] of Object.entries(tracks)) {
  tangents[name] = samples.map((sample, i) => {
    const prev = (i + times.length - 1) % times.length;
    const next = (i + 1) % times.length;
    const before = intervals[prev];
    const after = intervals[i];
    return sample.map((value, j) => {
      const risingIn = (value - samples[prev][j]) / before;
      const risingOut = (samples[next][j] - value) / after;
      if (risingIn * risingOut <= 0) return 0;
      const leftWeight = 2 * after + before;
      const rightWeight = after + 2 * before;
      return (leftWeight + rightWeight) / (leftWeight / risingIn + rightWeight / risingOut);
    });
  });
}

function samplePose(time) {
  const t = ((time % period) + period) % period;
  let i = times.length - 1;
  while (times[i] > t) i--;
  const next = (i + 1) % times.length;
  const duration = intervals[i];
  const s = (t - times[i]) / duration;
  const s2 = s * s;
  const s3 = s2 * s;
  const a = 2 * s3 - 3 * s2 + 1;
  const b = (s3 - 2 * s2 + s) * duration;
  const c = -2 * s3 + 3 * s2;
  const d = (s3 - s2) * duration;
  const pose = {};
  for (const [name, frames] of Object.entries(tracks)) {
    pose[name] = frames[i].map((value, j) =>
      a * value + b * tangents[name][i][j] + c * frames[next][j] + d * tangents[name][next][j]);
  }
  return pose;
}

function torsoPoint(x, y, z, shape) {
  const [shoulder, hip, height, drop, width, lean] = shape;
  const upper = 1 - smooth(y, 57, 176);
  const middle = 121 + (y - 115) * .09;
  return [
    middle + (x - middle) * width + lerp(hip, shoulder, upper),
    196 + (y - 196) * height + drop,
    z * (1 + .18 * (width - 1)) + lean * upper
  ];
}

function poseTorso(shape, headPose) {
  const p = body.geometry.attributes.position;
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    const j = i * 3;
    const [x, y, z] = torsoPoint(bodyRest[j] + 108, 108 - bodyRest[j + 1], bodyRest[j + 2], shape);
    p.setXYZ(i, x - 108, 108 - y, z);
  }
  p.needsUpdate = true;
  body.geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  body.geometry.computeBoundingBox();
  body.geometry.computeBoundingSphere();

  const [hx, hy, hz] = headPose;
  neck.pose(stageRows(neckRows.map(([y, x, z, w, depth]) => {
    const [bx, by, bz] = torsoPoint(x, y, z, shape);
    const blend = smooth(y, 42, 98);
    return [
      lerp(y + hy - 46, by, blend),
      lerp(x + hx - 120, bx, blend),
      lerp(z + hz - 24, bz, blend),
      w * lerp(1, shape[4], blend), depth
    ];
  })));
}

function poseLeg(leg, shift, drop) {
  leg.skin.pose(stageRows(leg.rows.map(([y, x, z, width, depth]) => {
    const bend = 1 - smooth(y, 174, 247);
    return [y + drop * bend, x + shift * bend, z + drop * .40 * bend, width, depth];
  })));
}

function poseArm(arm, centers, roll, compression, isRight) {
  const depthChanges = isRight ? [5,6,7,8,8,6,4,2,1] : [5,6,7,8,7,5,4,2,1];
  const widths = isRight ? [1,1,.96,.85,.74,.69,.78,.94,1] : [1,1,1,1,.99,.91,.88,.96,1];
  const rows = arm.rows.map(([, , z, w, depth], i) => [
    centers[2 * i + 1], centers[2 * i], z + compression * depthChanges[i],
    w * lerp(1, widths[i], compression), depth * lerp(1, widths[i], .55 * compression)
  ]);
  arm.skin.pose(stageRows(rows));
  const [baseX, baseY, baseZ] = arm.handBase;
  const [restY, restX, restZ] = arm.rows[arm.rows.length - 1];
  const [y, x, z] = rows[rows.length - 1];
  arm.hand.position.set(baseX + x - restX - 108, 108 - (baseY + y - restY), baseZ + z - restZ);
  arm.hand.rotation.set(-.19 * compression, (isRight ? -.10 : .12) * compression, roll);
}

function poseHead(pose) {
  const [x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw, width, height, opening] = pose;
  head.position.set(x - 108, 108 - y, z);
  head.rotation.set(pitch, yaw, roll, 'ZYX');
  head.scale.set(width, height, 1);
  for (const { geo, positions, rest, weights } of jawSurfaces) {
    for (let i = 0; i < positions.count; i++) {
      positions.setY(i, rest[i * 3 + 1] - opening * weights[i]);
    }
    positions.needsUpdate = true;
    geo.computeVertexNormals();
    geo.computeBoundingBox();
    geo.computeBoundingSphere();
  }
}

function render(t) {
  const pose = samplePose(t);
  poseTorso(pose.body, pose.head);
  poseLeg(leftLeg, pose.legs[0], pose.legs[2]);
  poseLeg(rightLeg, pose.legs[1], pose.legs[2]);
  poseArm(leftArm, pose.left, pose.wrists[0], pose.wrists[2], false);
  poseArm(rightArm, pose.right, pose.wrists[1], pose.wrists[2], true);
  poseHead(pose.head);
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}
